examples.explanation: One valid trace: shuffle to [3,1,2], reset restores [1,2,3], shuffle again to [2,3,1]. Any permutation is accepted for shuffle.
A single-element array has only one permutation.
Each shuffle must hold the same multiset; reset must restore the exact original order.

hints: Fisher-Yates: walk from the end, swapping each slot with a uniform earlier-or-equal slot.
Clone the input first so the caller's array is never mutated, and keep a pristine copy for reset.
The judge checks permutation equality, not the shuffle distribution.
title: 384. Shuffle an Array
